prompts.step1: Help me create a website for my new restaurant called Savory Seasons. It's a farm-to-table place and I need something clean and professional. Just get me started with the basic structure.
prompts.step2: Okay, that's a good skeleton. Now can you apply our brand's look and feel? We use earthy tones and a classic serif font. Let's get the styling foundation and a better navigation bar in place.
prompts.step3: This looks much better! Now can you make the hero section more visually appealing? Maybe add a nice restaurant photo and some smooth animations to make it feel more welcoming?
prompts.step4: Perfect! Now I need to showcase our menu. We have appetizers, main courses, and desserts. Can you add a menu section with some appetizing food photos? Our customers need to see what we offer.
prompts.step5: The menu looks fantastic! Now I need a way for customers to make reservations. Can you add a reservation system where they can book tables? I'd like fields for date, time, party size, and any special requests.
prompts.step6: We're almost there! Can you add a feedback section where customers can leave reviews with star ratings? Also, I need an About Us page that tells our farm-to-table story. Let's polish this up!

responses.step1: Perfect! I'll help you create a website for Savory Seasons. Let me start with a clean, simple foundation - just the basic HTML structure and minimal styling to get us going. I'm setting up the main sections you'll need: home, menu, reservations, and about.
responses.step2: Of course. I'll establish a design system using your brand's earthy colors and a classic serif font. I'm also updating the layout with a professional fixed navigation bar. This will set the visual tone for the rest of the site.
responses.step3: Great feedback! Now I'm making that hero section stand out. I'm generating a beautiful restaurant interior image and applying it as a full-screen background. I've also added some smooth 'fade-in' animations to make it feel welcoming and elegant.
responses.step4: Excellent! Now for the exciting part - your menu showcase. I'm building a complete menu section and generating 6 mouth-watering food images: 2 appetizers (bruschetta and burrata), 2 main courses (salmon and ribeye), and 2 desserts (cheesecake and chocolate lava cake). Each image is crafted to highlight the fresh, artisanal quality that defines farm-to-table dining.
responses.step5: Perfect! Your reservation system is now ready. I've created a comprehensive booking form with date/time selection, party size options, and a special requests field. Added proper validation and a confirmation system so customers get immediate feedback when they book. The styling matches your elegant restaurant aesthetic.
responses.step6: Almost done! I've added an interactive feedback system where customers can leave star ratings and written reviews. Also created a compelling About Us section that tells your farm-to-table story - focusing on your 2020 founding, local farm partnerships, and seasonal menu philosophy. Everything now works together seamlessly for a complete restaurant experience!

random1: Did you know that llamas can hum? They use humming as a way to communicate with each other!
random2: Llamas are related to camels, but they don't have humps. They're part of the camelid family, which also includes alpacas and vicuñas.
random3: A group of llamas is called a 'herd' or a 'pack', but wouldn't it be fun if it was called a 'llama drama'?
random4: Llamas have been used as guard animals for sheep because they're naturally protective and will chase away coyotes and other predators.
random5: The wool of a llama is naturally water-repellent and hypoallergenic. Llama wool sweaters, anyone?
random6: In the Inca Empire, only royalty were allowed to wear clothing made from llama fiber.
random7: Baby llamas are called 'crias', which means 'baby' in Spanish. They can weigh up to 30 pounds at birth!
random8: Llamas can carry 25-30% of their body weight for 8-13 miles a day. They're the pack mules of South America!
random9: Llamas are very social animals and prefer to live in herds. They're the party animals of the camelid world!
random10: The lifespan of a llama is about 20 years. That's a lot of time for llama drama!
random11: Llamas are used as therapy animals in some hospitals and care facilities. They're nature's fuzzy therapists!
random12: Llamas have excellent eyesight and can spot potential predators from a mile away. They're like the eagles of the grasslands!
random13: Llamas are environmentally friendly! Their padded feet are gentler on terrain than hooves, preventing erosion.
random14: Llama fiber comes in over 20 natural colors, the most of any fiber-producing animal. They're walking rainbows!
random15: Llamas are smart and can be trained to pull carts, carry packs, and even compete in obstacle courses. Llama Olympics, anyone?
random16: Llamas don't have teeth on their upper front jaw. Instead, they have a hard palate that helps them grind their food.
random17: Llamas communicate with each other using a variety of sounds including humming, neighing, and alarm calls.
random18: A llama's normal body temperature is much higher than a human's, ranging from 100.4 to 102.2°F (38-39°C).
random19: Switching from llamas: The fingerprints of a koala are so similar to humans that they have on occasion been confused at a crime scene.
random20: Switching gears from llamas: Did you know that a group of flamingos is called a 'flamboyance'? That's pretty fabulous!

credits.question: How do Generation Credits work?
credits.answer: Free includes {{freeCredits}} one-time credits. Pro includes {{proCredits}} credits each month. Every completed job consumes the amount shown in the pricing table.

service_tier.question: What changes with Priority service?
service_tier.answer: Priority service applies the configured {{multiplier}}× rate to the same generation job. Model, operation, quality, project, and user dimensions remain independently visible.

top_up.question: What happens when credits run low?
top_up.answer: Pro customers can optionally configure an automatic recharge from {{threshold}} to {{target}} credits. Manual purchases start at {{minimum}} credits, and Stripe-connected accounts collect the resulting invoice.

credits.question: What are credits and how do they work?
credits.answer: Credits are used to pay for AI services. Premium plans come with {{premiumCredits}} in monthly credits, while free plans get {{freeCredits}} in lifetime credits.

over_credits.question: What happens when I go over my credits?
over_credits.intro: When you exceed your credit allocation, you have flexible options to continue using our services:

auto_topup.title: Auto Top-Up
auto_topup.description: Set up automatic credit purchases to ensure uninterrupted service when your balance runs low.

credit_packs.title: Credit Packs
credit_packs.description: Purchase additional credits at any time with these convenient options:

rollover.question: Do unused credits roll over?
rollover.answer: Monthly credits reset each billing cycle and do not roll over. However, credits purchased through credit packs never expire.

change_plan.question: Can I change my plan at any time?
change_plan.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately, with prorated billing adjustments.
